name: pluck
description: A minimalist Mac video downloader with AI-assisted prompting and transcription
author: Bryan Owens

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:js:check && npm run lint:shell:check && npm run lint:py:check
scripts.lint:shell: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.sh"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs shellcheck'
scripts.lint:shell:check: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.sh"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs shellcheck'
scripts.lint:py: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.py"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs ruff check --fix'
scripts.lint:py:check: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.py"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs ruff check'
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:md && npm run format:shell && npm run format:py
scripts.format:check: npm run format:js:check && npm run format:md:check && npm run format:shell:check && npm run format:py:check
scripts.format:shell: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.sh"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs shfmt --write --simplify -i 2 -ci -bn'
scripts.format:shell:check: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.sh"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs shfmt --diff -i 2 -ci -bn'
scripts.format:py: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.py"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs ruff format'
scripts.format:py:check: sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files "*.py"); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | xargs ruff format --check'
